name: Gaslamp Lumpia Factory
blocked: Main menu is an image-only PDF (8.5x14 GLF Steampunk Menu AUG 2026.pdf) -- pdftotext -layout and -raw both return 2 bytes, no extractable text at all. The Weekend Brunch PDF (VALET FRAME - GLF BRUNCH MENU JUN 27 2025.pdf) has a text layer but it is a graphic multi-column layout where pdftotext separates every price block from every name block (raw mode dumps all ~20 refresher prices in one cluster and all 20 drink names in a separate cluster with no reliable line-level pairing); -layout produces plausible-looking but unverifiable pairs (e.g. two prices for two items with no way to tell which goes with which). No ordering platform (Toast/Square/Clover/etc) linked from the site, and no other priced source found. Address on site (423 F Street, San Diego) matches work list.
notes: Site is GoDaddy Website Builder; both /menu and /weekend-brunch-menu embed their content as PDFs rather than HTML. Neither PDF is safely extractable per playbook PDF rules. Needs a browser/visual read or a different source (dated Yelp/Google menu photo) to complete.

name: Wushiland Boba
notes: The restaurant own site (wushiland-usa.com) publishes an Allergen Guide image with drink names and calories but never a price anywhere -- confirmed by checking product-list.asp, individual product-info.asp pages, and the allergen PDF/JPG, none of which show pricing. Priced from the DoorDash marketplace store page (schema.org Menu JSON-LD), confirmed to be the correct branch by street address (7330 Clairemont Mesa Boulevard) matching the location-list.asp entry for this store. Prices are a consistent quarter-dollar-ending set (.49-.74); tested against 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25 divisors and none produced a clean round-number pattern, so treated as pass on the markup check, but this is a single delivery-marketplace source with no independent priced cross-check (the restaurants own site has no prices to compare against), hence medium confidence. Dropped the 12-item Most Ordered carousel -- every item in it duplicates an item already captured under its real category. Captured sections: Taro Latte, Brown Sugar Drinks, Yakult Drinks, Milk Tea, Green Tea, Black Tea, Four Seasons Tea, Latte. Missing: three Cheese Foam drinks (Cheese Foam Four Seasons Tea/Green Milk Tea/Ovaltine) that are marked NEW on the restaurants own allergen guide but do not appear anywhere in the DoorDash listing.
